name: cmdb_attr
label: CMDB Configuration Item Attribute Table
description: The CMDB configuration item attribute table is used for related query scenarios in configuration management, such as reporting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: ci_id
fields.description: Reference the ID from the ecmdb_ci. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: prop_id
fields.description: The attribute ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: target_ci_id
fields.description: Target_model_id. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: name
fields.description: English name. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: validator_id
fields.description: The component ID for the validator needs to be implemented in the code.

fields.name: is_unique
fields.description: 0 Is unique, 1 is similar unique, 2 is global unique.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_name
indexes.description: Standard index covering the name field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_prop_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the prop_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_target_ci_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the target_ci_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the ci_id, name fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
